name: 80 mm axial fan, 80 x 80 x 25 mm, 12 V (outlet on top)

mounts.note: origin = centre of the bottom face (inlet side) on the surface; the outlet is the top face, 25 mm up

accepts.note: the fan-to-duct adapter flange sits on the outlet face (25 mm = 0.9843 in); with the grill on the outlet the flange seats 3 mm higher (pos_by_option)

orient.label: Orientation

vertical.label: Vertical
vertical.note: standing on an edge, outlet faces +X (sideways); the node frame is rotated so everything on the outlet follows

orient.note: pose = how the fan node is rotated/lifted; applied in xr/scene.js poseOf (locals) and xr/compose.js matrixOf

inlet.label: inlet
inlet.note: 3 mm proud of the inlet face; lifted 3 mm when lying flat so it rests on the surface

notes: Generic 80 mm PC fan, design values: frame 80x80x25 r4, corner holes 4.3 on 71.5, 76 mm bore, hub 30 mm, 7 pitched blades, 3 struts and the airflow arrow on the outlet side.
